revenue_floor_policy.description: Cases are retained in the analysis, but evaluated relative revenue loss is capped at 100% whenever negative evaluated revenue would otherwise create a loss above 100%. Regression fits with a non-positive fitted price are retained with a 100% relative revenue loss; their prices are excluded from price-gap and pricing-direction metrics. AI rows without a valid answer remain excluded from matched comparisons.
